parties: Value Industries Limited (Debtor); Committee of Creditors
headline: Value Industries Limited – 64th Committee of Creditors Meeting Convened in CIRP
sum: Value Industries Limited is in active Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, with the 64th meeting of the Committee of Creditors scheduled for Friday, 21 August 2026. The pre-facto intimation signals ongoing resolution negotiations among creditors and resolution applicants.
implication: The number of CoC meetings (64th round) indicates a protracted resolution cycle, suggesting either complex creditor composition, multiple resolution bids under evaluation, or delayed creditor consensus-a marker for partners on timeline risk and potential precedent on extended CIRP durations under the Insolvency Code.
detail: Value Industries Limited, listed on NSE, has been subject to Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The 64th meeting of the Committee of Creditors-a strikingly high count-indicates the resolution process has progressed through multiple rounds of deliberation. Pre-facto intimation of the CoC meeting is a procedural requirement under IBBI regulations, signalling to creditors and stakeholders the agenda for formal decision-making on resolution plans or creditor-approved outcomes. The meeting is scheduled as a formal CoC session to evaluate and potentially vote on resolution proposals.
